pr_title: Enable non-blittable struct returns on UnmanagedCallersOnly
pr_body:
Now that #39294 is merged, we no longer need to require a stub when we return a non-primitive value type. This PR removes that restriction, which enabled using blittable value type returns with UnmanagedCallersOnly. This PR also enables passing the calling convention from UnmanagedCallersOnly to the JIT at both runtime and during crossgen with crossgen2. This enables the UnmanagedCallersOnly entrypoint to have the correct calling convention even though the entrypoint is technically managed.

This PR blocks crossgenning UnmangedCallersOnly methods in crossgen1 because the custom attribute parsing code is not currently included in crossgen1 and I didn't want to fight to get that hooked up since we're looking at deprecating/removing crossgen1 in the .NET 6 time frame anyway.

Fixes #35928.

issue_context.title: UnmanagedCallersOnlyAttribute returning non-primitive value types do not work
issue_context.body:
```
[UnmanagedCallersOnly]
static Vector2 MyCallback() { ... }
```

Expected: works fine
Actual: fails

More context: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/35926#discussion_r421165727
comments: I couldn't figure out the best area label to add to this issue. Please help me learn by adding exactly one [area label](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/docs/area-owners.md).
Since this depends on a fix for https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/12375 and #39294 isn't going to make .NET 5, I'm going to move this to .NET 6.
How is this going to work without marshal attributes ?
The returned value type must be a blittable value type. As a result, it doesn’t require marshalling and the marshal attributes aren’t needed.
